args:
exec /home/khalil/DataCleaning7.3/QuantFM/.venv/bin/python \
  -m quant_fm.scripts.k8s_dense230m_embeddings \
  --checkpoint quant_fm/runs/dense_230m_v1/run/best.pt \
  --manifest quant_fm/runs/cont60/data/manifest.json \
  --emb-dir quant_fm/runs/dense_230m_v1/embeddings \
  --splits train val test \
  --num-gpus 8 \
  --batch-size 16
containers.name: embeddings

args:
expected_days=61
done_dir=quant_fm/runs/oos2026_dense230/data/.done
manifest=quant_fm/runs/oos2026_dense230/data/manifest.json
historical_job=dense230m-historical-embeddings-20260728
oos_job=dense230m-oos-signal-20260728

while true; do
  historical_complete="$(kubectl -n khalil get job "$historical_job" -o jsonpath='{.status.conditions[?(@.type=="Complete")].status}')"
  done_days=0
  if [ -d "$done_dir" ]; then
    done_days="$(find "$done_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f | wc -l)"
  fi
  manifest_bytes=0
  if [ -f "$manifest" ]; then
    manifest_bytes="$(wc -c < "$manifest")"
  fi
  echo "[$(date -Is)] historical=$historical_complete done_days=$done_days/$expected_days manifest_bytes=$manifest_bytes"

  if [ "$historical_complete" = "True" ] && \
     [ "$done_days" -ge "$expected_days" ] && \
     [ "$manifest_bytes" -gt 1000 ]; then
    kubectl -n khalil patch job "$oos_job" --type=merge -p '{"spec":{"suspend":false}}'
    echo "[$(date -Is)] released $oos_job"
    exit 0
  fi
  sleep 120
done
containers.name: release
